cameras.name: Living Room
cameras.note: RTSP switched on in the eufy app; username and password are the ones set on that screen.

cameras.name: Back Door
cameras.note: Smart Life camera. ONVIF switched on in the app, password reset there (needs a capital letter). "url": "auto" finds the port and path, because Tuya models differ and some change it after a reboot.

cameras.name: Landing
cameras.note: Yi IoT camera running yi-hack. "url": "auto" finds the path; without the hack firmware there is no local stream to find.

cameras.name: Front Garden
cameras.note: VicoHome battery camera: no local stream, so this tile opens their app.
